claim_boundary: Local single-node pacing calibration only; no production SLA, HA, multi-GPU, or customer-traffic claim.
corrective_action: Preserve the fixed 250 ms p99 and 100 ms queue-wait operating SLO.
Calibrate a public-safe absolute operating-rate ceiling with three independent non-acceptance repetitions.
Bind S2 queue recalculation to the validated open-loop service rate rather than the closed-loop saturation rate.
next_action: Freeze the three-repeat 80 RPS pilot result as an operating ceiling and rerun the complete acceptance matrix.
root_cause: After catch-up bursts were removed, a 107.4 RPS calibration still delivered only 96.99 percent of the frozen rate and exceeded both operating tail-latency limits. The result therefore identifies a real local sustainable-capacity boundary rather than an accepted operating point.
